text:
alex: quick idea — can we add a lightweight matrix-check + swapback flag to the deploy bot? thinking: run a small matrix of smoke checks post-rollout, then if X% fail in Y window, auto-swapback to previous pin. keep the command concise. :thinking_face:

maria: love it. do you mean something like automated canary criteria but simpler (matrix = multiple probes: api-liveness, p50-latency, model-accuracy on a sentinel set)? :eyes:

sam: yes. and make the thresholds configurable per-service. default sensible values in deploy-bot config. :+1:

alex: exactly. strawman command:```/deploy start --env=prod --pin=release-2026-03 --matrix=smoke1,smoke2,accuracy --matrix-window=10m --swapback-threshold=30%```

jen: question — where do we store the sentinel evals for accuracy? commit to repo or a short-lived S3 object? and who owns the baseline? :warning:

maria: keep it in the repo under infra/deploy/sentinels/*.json, small lists only. ops owns infra sentinels, teams can add service-specific ones. doc link: https://internal.redwood/devex/deploy/sentinels

sam: propose default matrix: [api-liveness, p50, p99-errors, sentinel-accuracy]. p50 threshold = +200ms over baseline triggers a warning, p99-errors > 1% triggers failure. joust with numbers later.

alex: good. also want a dry-run helper and a compact release-note injection:```/deploy start ... --preview-notes "fixed tokenization regression; pinned to rwd-encoder-v3"``` so deploy-bot can auto-attach short notes to the rollout timeline.

jen: love the preview-notes flag. saves manual copy/paste in console. :clap:

maria: operational behavior: deploy-bot will run matrix probes in parallel during the matrix-window. if failures >= swapback-threshold then bot triggers swapback flow: notify #incidents, set traffic back to previous variant, mark rollout as failed, and create a rollback ticket (prefilled).

alex: outline for swapback flow in playbook snippet:```- record previous pin/version
- start probes
- collect probe results into a small report
- if failure_condition met:
  - announce to channel with summary
  - run /deploy swapback --to <previous-pin> --reason "matrix-fail: <summary>"
  - create ticket in ops backlog template
  - attach probe-report to ticket
else:
  - finalize rollout and annotate release notes
```

ci-bot: build 2065504 started for release-2026-03. status: queued.

deploy-bot: acknowledged. when you call /deploy start I will: pin version, warm caches, run matrix probes, and enforce swapback policy if configured. see `/deploy help matrix` for flags. :robot_face:

sam: small UX ask — make the matrix result a compact emoji row in the channel summary, e.g., :white_check_mark: :warning: :x:, with hover details. easier to scan during change windows.

jen: and a one-click 'accept' button for on-call to bypass swapback for urgent deploys (with strong gate: must be a specific role + reason required).

alex: agreed. can we also have an annotation field for release notes that lists which probes were measured and snapshots of key metrics? minimal and machine readable. e.g., `probes=[api:ok,p50:+30ms,sentinel:0.98]`

maria: I'll open a tiny RFC in docs: infra/deploy/matrix-swapback.md with proposed flags, defaults, and playbook. assigning sam for thresholds, jen for UX, alex for CLI syntax.

alex: thanks — i'll prototype the deploy-bot handler and a small script that converts probe outputs to the emoji summary. will post a demo GIF in the thread when ready. :shipit:

jen: ping me when demo is up, I can put together the Console layout for the matrix summary widget.

maria: capturing action items:
- alex: prototype handler + emoji summary (due in 3d)
- sam: define default probe thresholds and fail criteria (2d)
- jen: design one-click bypass UX + Console widget (4d)
- maria: write RFC + sentinel storage convention (1d)

alex: thanks all. small example command I'll use in prototype:```/deploy start --env=prod --pin=release-2026-03 --matrix-window=8m --matrix=api,p50,sentinel --swapback-threshold=25% --preview-notes "pin rwd-enc-v3, quick smoke" --dry-run=false```

deploy-bot: demo mode enabled for prototype channels. remember to run `/deploy dry-run` to validate flags without changing traffic. :warning:

sam: neat. if we make the swapback idempotent and safe it'll remove a lot of manual rollbacks. happy to help test.

alex: will post follow-ups. end of thread.
